Venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association

Title: The utility of hotspot mapping for predicting spatial patterns of crime
Key_Claim: Evaluated spatial hotspot predictive accuracy across multiple density estimation techniques.

ANVESHA_Comparison: Relies on high-frequency telecommunications data; ANVESHA operates on official public safety compendiums with strict temporal safeguards.

Title: Spatio-temporal crime prediction using deep learning
Key_Claim: Applied ST-GCN models for crime forecasting across urban grid cells.
ANVESHA_Comparison: Evaluates complex neural architectures; ANVESHA demonstrates that simple rolling-mean baselines match complex models on sparse district panels.

Title: Predictive policing: The role of crime forecasting in law enforcement operations

ANVESHA_Comparison: Emphasizes ethical boundaries; ANVESHA integrates responsible non-causal interpretation protocols to prevent individual risk profiling.
